accounting.journal_entry.name: Journal entry
accounting.error.account_code_taken: This account code is already in use.
accounting.error.account_parent_invalid: Invalid parent account: it must have the same type and be neither this account nor one of its children.
accounting.error.account_in_use: The account has entries or is in use, so it cannot be changed. Retire it instead.
accounting.error.account_not_postable: The account has children or is retired. Choose an active postable account.
accounting.error.start_date_fixed: The legal entity already has entries, so its start date cannot change.
accounting.error.entry_unbalanced: The entry does not balance: it needs at least two lines and debits equal to credits.
accounting.error.journal_entry_unbalance: The journal entry does not balance: debits must equal credits. Correct the line amounts and try again.
accounting.error.line_side_invalid: Line {{line_no}}: enter an amount on exactly one side, debit or credit.
accounting.error.line_amount_invalid: Line {{line_no}}: the amount is too large.
accounting.error.line_org_unit_invalid: Line {{line_no}}: the org unit is not part of the entry's legal entity.
accounting.error.journal_entry_too_many_: The journal entry has too many lines. Split it into several entries.
accounting.error.accounting_not_started: The legal entity does not use accounting on this date. Check its start date under Configuration.
accounting.error.invalid_range: Invalid date range: the start must come before the end.
accounting.error.start_date_in_locked_pe: The legal entity has a period locked until {{locked_until}}, so the start date cannot move into it.
accounting.error.rule_partner_mismatch: A kind that names a partner maps only to an account tracked by partner, and the other way round.
accounting.error.account_partner_rule_mi: A mapping rule uses this account and would no longer match. Change the rule first.
accounting.error.entry_partner_mismatch: The entry's partners do not match how its accounts are tracked.
accounting.error.journal_line_partner_re: Line {{line_no}}: the account is tracked by partner. Choose a partner.
accounting.error.journal_line_partner_no: Line {{line_no}}: the account is not tracked by partner. Remove the partner.
accounting.error.account_not_tracked: The account is not tracked by partner. Choose one that is.
